fields.label: Description
fields.value: A safe workflow for containing and restoring a suspected compromised network appliance.

fields.label: Steps
value: Isolate the device from untrusted networks.
Preserve relevant logs and evidence when practical.
Restore known-good vendor firmware or replace unsupported hardware.
Rotate credentials and close exposed management/service paths.
Patch, verify, and monitor before returning the device to service.
